options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the state machine

options.name: --definition
options.description: The Amazon States Language definition of the state machine. See Amazon States Language

options.name: --role-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role of the state machine

options.name: --logging-configuration
options.description: Use the LoggingConfiguration data type to set CloudWatch Logs options

options.name: --tracing-configuration
options.description: Selects whether X-Ray tracing is enabled

options.name: --publish
options.description: Specifies whether the state machine version is published. The default is false. To publish a version after updating the state machine, set publish to true

options.name: --no-publish
options.description: Specifies whether the state machine version is published. The default is false. To publish a version after updating the state machine, set publish to true

options.name: --version-description
options.description: An optional description of the state machine version to publish. You can only specify the versionDescription parameter if you've set publish to true

options.name: --encryption-configuration
options.description: Settings to configure server-side encryption

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: update-state-machine-alias
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an existing state machine alias by modifying its description or routingConfiguration.

options.name: --state-machine-alias-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the state machine alias

options.name: --description
options.description: A description of the state machine alias

options.name: --routing-configuration
options.description: The routing configuration of the state machine alias.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

subcommands.name: validate-state-machine-definition
subcommands.description: Validates the syntax of a state machine definition specified in Amazon States Language (ASL), a JSON-based, structured language.

options.name: --definition
options.description: The Amazon States Language definition of the state machine. For more information, see Amazon States Language (ASL)

options.name: --type
options.description: The target type of state machine for this definition. The default is STANDARD

options.name: --severity
options.description: Minimum level of diagnostics to return. ERROR returns only ERROR diagnostics, whereas WARNING returns both WARNING and ERROR diagnostics. The default is ERROR

options.name: --max-results
options.description: The maximum number of diagnostics that are returned per call. The default and maximum value is 100. Setting the value to 0 will also use the default of 100.
